WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_daily_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) AS avg_across_ratings
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT AVG(r.avg_daily_price) AS avg_daily_price_of_above_average_ratings,
       AVG(r.avg_daily_price - o.avg_across_ratings) AS avg_excess_above_across_rating_average
FROM rating_averages r
CROSS JOIN overall_average o
WHERE r.avg_daily_price > o.avg_across_ratings
